description: PROPOSAL FOR SINGLE STOREY REAR & FRONT EXTENSIONS
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>Notwithstanding the&nbsp;Preliminary
Ecological Appraisal and Roost Assessment [Issue 1.0, dated 19/03/2025,
received 20/03/2025] prior&nbsp;to the completion of the development at least 1 x Bat brick or 1 x Bat Box (Habitat Bird Box, Ibstock Enclosed Bat Box or similar alternative brand) should be positioned at least 3-5 metres up from the ground level and should face in a south or south-westerly direction. The bat box shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The
proposed development shall otherwise be implemented in accordance with the
approved &nbsp;Preliminary Ecological Appraisal and Roost Assessment [Issue
1.0, dated 19/03/2025, received 20/03/2025], in particular with regard to lighting mitigation.</span><br></p>
